title: Turkey Creek, Copperas Cove, TX - By Brian E Adams, Realtor with StarPointe Realty
description:
Turkey Creek is a mid-sized golf course community on the North-East corner of Copperas Cove, next to the Hills of Cove city golf course.  The neighborhood features homes built over nearly three decades, from the early 1980s to mid 2000s, and offers a wide range of sizes between 1300 and over 3000 square feet. Turkey Creek is a quiet neighborhood but still close to the action like Highway 190, the Copperas Cove downtown and shopping, and the Tank Destroyer gate to Fort Hood. It is a great option for golfers or anyone looking for affordable homes in the beautiful hills of the Copperas Cove Hill Country.
